description: A team of driven university students in Singapore
summary: Moon Sweet Moon is an interactive lunar outpost management game that introduces children aged 7–12 to the engineering challenges of keeping astronauts alive on the Moon. Players manage limited resources across life support, power, food production and radiation protection, making decisions that directly affect their crew's survival. By integrating real solar activity records from NASA's DONKI database, each mission connects gameplay with authentic space-weather information, creating fresh challenges that encourage players to return, adapt their strategies and learn through experimentation. Ultimately, the game makes aerospace engineering accessible while teaching resource management, systems thinking and the principle that every engineering decision has a consequence.
details:
WHAT IT DOES

Moon Sweet Moon is a free daily browser game for ages 7 to 12. Each day's mission is built from what the real Sun did yesterday, using solar flare records from NASA's DONKI database. The player runs a small Moon outpost for three shifts. They share a few batteries between four rooms (air, farm, shelter and lab) and keep three crew healthy: a plant scientist, a power engineer and a medic. A storm forecast shows each storm's chance and likely size. When a real flare hits, a ready shelter keeps the crew safe.

BENEFITS

Children practise the kind of trade-off real mission planners face: there is never enough power for everything. They learn that solar flares come in sizes (C, M, X), that forecasts can be wrong, and that some days cannot be won, which is okay. Every fun fact, building and space pet links to a NASA page.

INTENDED IMPACT

Very few people ever become astronauts. We want any curious child with a browser to try thinking like one. No login, no download, no cost.

TOOLS

One HTML file with plain JavaScript, CSS and SVG. NASA DONKI API for flare data. Helioviewer API for NASA Solar Dynamics Observatory photos. Supabase for anonymous daily totals. Browser speech and audio for voices and music. GitHub Pages for hosting. Python and Playwright for testing. Claude (AI) helped write code, text and graphics.

HOW IT IS CREATIVE

It is a new puzzle every day, like a daily word game, but the puzzle comes from the real Sun. Stars are scored against the best plan that day's Sun allowed, so a careful child is never punished for a harsh day. A daily Captain's order, 7 buildings for a Moon land and 4 space pets (real species from NASA research) give reasons to come back.

WHAT WE CONSIDERED

Fair scoring and kind failure. Honest science: we say what is simplified, for example every flare is treated as a storm. Young players: voices read every line, numbers are small, and a training mission teaches the rules. Privacy: no accounts and no personal data.
